name: Judith
title: The Heroine of Bethulia
summary: Judith is mentioned in Genesis as one of Esau's wives. She was the daughter of the Hittite Beeri and married Esau, which caused grief for his parents Isaac and Rebekah. The name Judith means 'praised' or 'from Judah'.

keyEvents.title: Esau's Marriage
keyEvents.description: Esau took Judith, the daughter of the Hittite Beeri, as his wife when he was forty years old.

keyEvents.title: A Source of Grief for Isaac and Rebekah
keyEvents.description: Judith and Basemath, Esau's Hittite wives, were a bitter grief to Isaac and Rebekah because of their pagan background.

keyEvents.title: Rebekah's Concern about Hittite Women
keyEvents.description: Rebekah expressed her frustration to Isaac over the Hittite women and feared that Jacob would also marry one of the daughters of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Isaac Sends Jacob Away
keyEvents.description: Because of the experiences with Esau's Hittite wives, including Judith, Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-Aram to find a wife from his own family.
